description: Triaged Slither findings for the canonical V2 scope. Every entry is a reviewed disposition. Only 'false-positive' and 'accepted-risk' suppress a finding, and both require a justification of at least minJustificationLength characters plus reviewer metadata. Deleting an entry, or adding one without justification, fails scripts/static-analysis-gate.mjs.

entries.justification: RelayerRegistry.setRelayer validates the relayer address via _requireNonZeroRelayer, which reverts with RelayerRegistry_ZeroRelayer when the argument is address(0). Slither does not follow the internal helper across the call boundary, so the finding is a tooling limitation rather than a missing guard.

TimelockController.setGovernance and setPauser both route through _requireNon0Zero, which reverts with TimelockController_ZeroAddress on address(0). The guard is present and tested in TimelockController.test.ts; Slither reports the external entrypoint without inlining the helper.

RelayerRegistry emits RelayerUpdated and RelayerRemoved on every mutation of the authorized relayer set. The accepted-risk disposition covers the remaining Slither noise on internal cache updates that do not change authorization state; the authorization boundary itself is evented and tested.

TimelockController emits GovernanceUpdated, PauserUpdated, and CooldownUpdated on every governance, pauser, and cooldown mutation. The accepted-risk disposition covers Slither noise on internal derived getters that do not mutate authorization state.

AllowanceManager emits AllowanceUpdated on every allowance mutation and reverts on overflow via SafeMath. The accepted-risk disposition covers Slither noise on internal accounting variables whose derived values are not authority-bearing and are asserted by the allowance change test suite.
